Title: Hydroponic Tomatoes: pH, EC, Light, Spacing & Pruning
Description: Hydroponic tomatoes: pH 5.8–6.2, EC 2.0–3.0 mS/cm, DLI above 20, 80 °F days and 60 °F nights. Train one stem 16–20 in apart; first fruit about 10 weeks. Free guide from HydroRigor, with figures from university and extension research.
Keywords: hydroponic tomatoes, hydroponics, indoor gardening, grow vegetables indoors
